title: Figure 11: T2 value analysis summary - implant vs control hemispheres bar chart
description: Bar chart with error bars plotting "T2 value (ms)" (0-60) against "TimePost-Implant(Days)" at 0, 7, 14, 28 and 42 days, comparing "Implant" and "Control" hemispheres, all near 50 ms. The caption "Figure 11. T2 Value Analysis Summary of T2 Values in All the Image Slices That Spanned the Electrode Arrays in All Animals" reports no significant difference and lists p-values per day. Text below introduces hybrid neuro-robotic systems using lamprey brainstem.
